trial_court: Patiala House Courts, New Delhi, CS No.754 of 2017
case_name: Karan Nath vs Minakshi Nath And Ors

parties.respondent_defendant: Mrs. Minakshi Nath Srinivasan, Mrs. Vinita Nath Sharma, and Shukla Kailash Nath (defendants)

facts_of_case: The plaintiff seeks a declaration that the deed of settlement dated 01/07/1992 between the defendants be declared as null and void.

legal_principles.principle: A compromise decree has attained finality.
legal_principles.held: It is submitted that when the defendant no. 4 himself was estopped from challenging the family settlement in view of the compromise and the decree in terms of the compromise, the plaintiff could also not challenge the family settlement by claiming any rights through the defendant no. 4.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 — Order VII Rule 11

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot challenge a family settlement when they have agreed to abide by it.
legal_principles.held: It is submitted that the defendant no. 4 herein had agreed to abide by the family settlement dated 01/07/1992 and had confirmed that the subject property shall be owned by the plaintiffs no. 1 and 2 only in terms of the family settlement dated 01/07/1992.

legal_principles.principle: A suit cannot be dismissed under Order XII Rule 6 CPC or rejected under Order VII Rule 11 CPC without a trial.
legal_principles.held: It is submitted that the plaintiff has raised serious triable issues, and that at this stage, without a trial, the suit cannot be dismissed under Order XII Rule 6 CPC or be rejected under Order VII Rule 11 CPC.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 — Order XII Rule 6
Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 — Order VII Rule 11

outcome.final_order: The application filed by the defendants to dismiss the suit under Order XII Rule 6 CPC is allowed.
